about_short_description.short_description: Misr Petroleum is a major lubricant manufacturing and marketing company.

identifier.value: Lubricating Oils Blending and Greases Manufacture Plant (Amriya)

product.name: Lubricating Oils Blending and Greases Manufacture Plant (Amriya)
product.description: A plant producing lubricating oils and greases with a capacity of 150,000 tons and 1,500 tons per year respectively, using automated blending systems.

identifier.value: Lubricating Oils Blending and Greases Manufacture Plant (Mafroza)

product.name: Lubricating Oils Blending and Greases Manufacture Plant (Mafroza)
product.description: A plant producing lubricating oils and greases with annual capacities of 30,000 tons and 500 tons respectively, using blending processes.

product.name: Chemical Products Division
product.description: Production of chemical products including detergents, solvents, pesticides, insecticides, and sulfonic acid for industrial and agricultural use.

product.name: Drums Recycling and Reclamation Factory
product.description: A factory that reclaims and recycles packaging drums to meet company packaging needs and reduce environmental waste.

product.name: Plastic Small Cans Factory
product.description: A factory producing high-density polyethylene plastic cans with an annual output of 2.5 million cans for packaging purposes.

identifier.value: Base Oils Storage and Handling Facilities

product.name: Base Oils Storage and Handling Facilities
product.description: Storage and handling of local and imported base oils with large capacity tanks, pipelines, pumps, and trucking fleets for internal use and third-party companies.
